statement.text:
A nonempty class $\mathcal X$ of finite groups is said to be complete if $\mathcal X$ is closed under taking subgroups, homomorphic images, and extensions. The symmetric boundary of a complete class $\mathcal X$ other than the class of all finite groups is defined as the largest integer $n$ such that $S_n\in\mathcal X$. For every positive integer $n\ne 3$, let $f_+(n)$ and $f_-(n)$ be respectively the maximum and the minimum of $\operatorname{BS}(\mathcal X)$, where $\mathcal X$ runs over all complete classes of symmetric boundary $n$.

(a) Find $f_+(n)$ for $n=4,5,6$.

(b) Is it true that $f_-(n)=n$ for all $n\ne 3$?
